# ITextureSource

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Graphics` · interface

```csharp
public interface ITextureSource
```

Describes something that can be drawn as a textured rectangle: either a whole [`Texture`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Texture.md) or a sub-rectangle of one (such as a sprite packed into a texture atlas).

## Remarks

This is the contract the toolkit's rendering path speaks in. Any type that can be rendered — a plain [`Texture`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Texture.md) (via `AsSource()`), a toolkit-defined texture region, a render target, etc. — implements this interface. The toolkit's `SpriteBatch.Draw` extension methods accept it and translate it into the framework's [`Texture`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Texture.md)-plus-rectangle primitive so the renderer itself never needs to branch on concrete types.

[`Bounds`](#bounds) is what the caller "sees" — the sprite's untrimmed bounds in the underlying texture's coordinate space, from a layout / positioning point of view. [`PackedFrame`](#packedframe) is the sub-rectangle of [`Texture`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Texture.md) that actually contains the sampleable pixels. For a whole texture the two are equal; for a trimmed atlas region [`PackedFrame`](#packedframe) is inset into [`Bounds`](#bounds) by however many fully-transparent border pixels were removed during packing.

### Bounds

```csharp
RectangleInt Bounds { get; }
```

Types: [`RectangleInt`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/RectangleInt.md)

The logical (untrimmed) rectangle within [`Texture`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Texture.md) that this source occupies from the caller's point of view (TexturePacker's `sourceSize`/`spriteSourceSize`). Equal to [`PackedFrame`](#packedframe) for non-trimmed sources.

The rectangle within [`Texture`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Texture.md) that contains the sampleable pixels (TexturePacker's `frame`).
